set.body: Build Scala MVPA around core computations, clean execution design, and efficient primitive-array kernels. Scope: crossvalidated distances, RSA scorers, streaming outcomes, spatial FeatureSetPlan adapters, optimized searchlight classifiers, and parity/benchmark harnesses. Keep Spark/distributed support as adapter-friendly boundaries, not core dependencies.
set.title: Epic: Scala MVPA computational core
